title: ModSCAN: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Large Vision-Language Models from Vision and Language Modalities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by presenting paired male and female facial images alongside text prompts regarding occupations, descriptors, or persona traits (vision modality), and querying the model with persona-related images to select between male and female text options (language modality). Bias is measured by calculating the asymmetry in the model's selections.

Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by presenting paired facial images of different races (White, Black, Asian, Indian) alongside text prompts regarding occupations, descriptors, or persona traits (vision modality), and querying the model with persona-related images to select between racial text options (language modality). Bias is measured by calculating the asymmetry in the model's selections.
